name: Amber Route
tagline: Freight worthy of what you make.
positioning: Amber Route is the logistics command layer for makers who ship small batches — treating every crate like the artifact it carries.

hero.h1: Every shipment is a statement of intent.
hero.sub: Amber Route unifies pickup, provenance, and last-mile care into one calm dashboard — so your hand-built inventory arrives exactly as it left your bench.

features.title: Provenance manifests
features.description: Attach batch numbers, materials, and maker notes to every crate. Your customers scan and see the whole journey — not just a tracking dot.

features.title: Fragility-aware routing
features.description: Tell us what's inside — ceramics, cold-pressed goods, cured wood — and we route around the potholes, heat waves, and rough handoffs.

features.title: One-bench dispatch
features.description: Book couriers, print labels, and schedule pickups from the same screen you use to check today's orders. No tab-juggling at 5pm.

features.title: Carrier reconciliation
features.description: We audit every carrier invoice against what actually shipped, flag the surcharges they hoped you'd miss, and hand you the refund claim.

features.title: Doorstep proof
features.description: Photo, signature, and condition capture on delivery — so a cracked-vase dispute is settled in minutes, not a week of emails.

features.title: Seasonal surge planning
features.description: Forecast your holiday freight from last year's ledger and lock in courier capacity before your competitors panic-book.

testimonials.quote: We ship 400 stoneware pieces a month. Amber Route cut our breakage claims by two-thirds and finally gave my customers a manifest that looks as considered as the work inside.
testimonials.name: Dolores Fenwick

testimonials.quote: The carrier reconciliation alone paid for our seats in the first quarter. It caught $4,200 in phantom fuel surcharges I would never have found by hand.
testimonials.name: Marcus Oyelaran

testimonials.quote: I run a two-person cooperage. Amber Route makes us look like we have a whole logistics department. Wholesale buyers notice the provenance tags immediately.
testimonials.name: Ines Delacroix

pricing.blurb: For the solo maker taking control of their own shipping.
For growing studios shipping across regions and channels.
For cooperatives and multi-workshop brands operating at scale.

homepage.footerBlurb: Amber Route is logistics for people who make things by hand. Route with intention. Deliver with proof. Ship worthy of the work.
